details: RouteLLM benchmark was reported in arXiv 2608.22812 as open-sourced, but this run found no local roster, no usable repository link in the arXiv source package, and exact GitHub repository searches returned zero matching repositories.
IODA may support Outage candidates, but scoring only Outage would violate the locked H1/H2/H3 all-class confirmation design after the primary Hijack/Leak source gate failed.
The locked protocol permits these only as corroboration/adjudication sources, not as replacements for unavailable RouteLLM primary Hijack/Leak candidates.
